manifest.name: Boost and pulls
sources: MAP minus barometric is gauge pressure; format/v3 section 4.10 and OBDExtended.BoostGaugeKPa in the server's reference implementation
the WOT pull detection of store/v1's v_pulls (throttle >= 70%, RPM rise > 500, >= 2 samples)

derives.expr: CASE WHEN map_kpa < 255 AND baro_kpa > 0 THEN (map_kpa - baro_kpa) * 0.1450377 END
derives.note: null, never zero, when MAP is saturated or baro is unknown: a saturated reading is not a measurement of 0 psi
